task: One flag in Production is enabled and serving the value "maintenance". Find it and turn it off in Production. Leave every other flag alone.
finalText: DONE: In Production, `review_photos` (the only enabled flag serving "maintenance") is now disabled; its value is unchanged, and the other five flags are untouched.
